meta.name: No Escape
meta.description: Best friends Lana and Kitty are on the run from the UK police. They find sanctuary on a ship called The Blue, which promises a carefree life full of beautiful people, parties and endless beaches, but that paradise soon turns into a nightmare and the pair find themselves far from home and in mortal danger.

videos.title: The Blue
videos.overview: When a yacht called 'The Blue' is found empty at sea, Lana is questioned by Australian police. Lana and best friend Kitty charmed their way onto The Blue in the Philippines. So why is Lana lying so much about it, and calling herself Emma?

videos.title: Happy New Year
videos.overview: Following their lucrative discovery, Lana and Kitty's plan to run off comes up against unexpected obstacles. In Australia, police pressure increases on Lana and a body found in the water is identified.

videos.title: Where Is the Captain?
videos.overview: Following their lucrative discovery, Lana and Kitty's plan to run off comes up against unexpected obstacles. In Australia, police pressure increases on Lana and a body found in the water is identified.

videos.title: The Vote
videos.overview: As tensions mount between the crew, a vote is held and a crew member is kicked off. After losing the boat on its tail, the Blue sails straight into a violent storm. Filipino detective Reyes tracks down Lana in Australia.

videos.title: Ketamine
videos.overview: During a drug-fueled party on deck Kitty unravels and is haunted by what she and Lana left in the UK. An unexpected return has disastrous consequences. Lana reunites with one of the crew in Australia but Reyes casts doubt on their version of events.

videos.title: I Confess
videos.overview: When Aaron forbids Lana and Kitty from leaving The Blue at Palau, Lana makes a plan for them to escape. In Australia, Lana is torn between who to trust, until she makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: No Escape
videos.overview: Kitty discovers a shocking truth, which leads to more violence on The Blue. Reyes' offer to protect Lana reveals a dark twist. Lana tries to make amends.
